title: Mod Scenario – Unit Type Definitions
description: Fragment file: defines custom unit types introduced by this scenario/mod.

ScenarioUnitTypeDefinition.description: A unit type. When no content file (Content/units.json or the scenario's unitsOverrideFile) defines this id, it becomes a recruitable unit that copies cost, upkeep, required building and prerequisites from a base unit of its category, with the stats below laid on top.

id.description: Unique identifier for this unit type, e.g. 'my_mod.elite_infantry'

ownerIso3.description: If set, only this country can recruit this unit type; every other country keeps its own units. Leave empty for all countries. See the scenario's restrictOwnersToOwnedUnits.

category.description: Broad unit category. A unit type nothing else defines copies its cost and requirements from this base unit: infantry and cavalry from infantry, artillery, armor and special_forces from their namesakes, naval from frigate, air from fighter.
